# RFC 2578 section 3.6 gives every descriptor its own OBJECT IDENTIFIER
# value, so two descriptors at { acme 1 } is the MIB contradicting
# itself and one of them cannot be the node a walk arrives at. The
# conceptual table wins the arc because its row and its columns are
# classified against it, and acmeSlot — which only names the arc — is
# reported as the one with no place in the tree.
code smi/duplicate-oid
